svg.title: WayBionic Ground Station — Software Architecture
svg.desc: Editable vector architecture diagram showing controller, ROS 2 teleoperation, collision and joint limits, carrier CAN, drives, arm, camera, RViz and diagnostics. Hardware path unverified by powered tests.
svg.text: Controller-to-arm commands • encoder feedback • independent doctor view • live diagnostics
Same drive node, in-process CAN simulator;
Architecture implemented in software; powered-arm validation not established.
